agency.tip: Check that the website belongs to the agency before you share personal details. Real agencies never ask you to pay to be represented.

share.title: Your public link
share.offBody: Share your profile on Instagram, WhatsApp or your CV. Anyone with the link can see your photo, discipline, city, story and work, never your age, email or phone number. It is off until you turn it on.
share.onBody: Anyone with this link can see your profile and work, even without an account. Your age, email and phone number stay hidden.
share.copyFailed: Your browser did not allow copying. Select the link and copy it yourself.
share.text: See my work on Raising Talents

shared.notAvailableBody: The link may be old, or the talent has made their profile private.
shared.failed: We could not load this profile
shared.failedBody: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
shared.agentBody: Verified agencies can send a contact request. Talent choose who they talk to.
shared.talentTitle: Have a talent of your own?
shared.talentBody: Build a profile like this in minutes and get found by verified agents across Nigeria.

auth.panelTitle: Where Nigeria's next stars meet the people who scout them.

messages.title: Messages
messages.subtitleTalent: Requests from verified agents, and your chats with the ones you accepted.
messages.subtitleAgent: Your contact requests and chats with talent.
messages.emptyTalentBody: When a verified agent wants to contact you, their request appears here. You choose who you talk to.
messages.emptyAgentBody: Find talent you like and send a contact request from their profile.
messages.notFoundBody: It may have been withdrawn, or the account may no longer exist.
messages.requestBody: Read their message. If you accept, you can chat here. They never see your email address or phone number unless you share them.
messages.declineConfirm: Decline this request? {agency} will be told, and cannot ask again for 30 days.
messages.safety: Stay safe: keep conversations on Raising Talents, and never pay a fee to be represented or auditioned.
messages.waitingBody: We told them about your request. You will hear from us as soon as they answer.
messages.withdrawnBody: You can send a new one from their profile at any time.
messages.declinedBody: You can ask again 30 days after they declined. Many talented people are waiting to be discovered.
messages.closed: This conversation is closed, so new messages cannot be sent.
messages.blockBody: Neither of you will be able to send messages here. They are not told that you blocked them. You can unblock at any time.
messages.blockRequestBody: This also declines their request, and they cannot ask again. They are not told that you blocked them. You can unblock at any time.
messages.blockedBody: They cannot send you messages or new requests here.

contact.title: Contact {name}
contact.body: Introduce yourself and say what the opportunity is. {name} will read it and choose whether to chat.
contact.messageHint: At least 20 characters. Say who you are, your agency and why you are reaching out.
contact.tooShort: Write at least 20 characters so they know who you are.
contact.sentBody: We will tell you when {name} answers.
contact.waiting: Your request is waiting for {name} to answer
contact.declined: {name} declined your last request. You can ask again 30 days after they declined.
contact.needVerified: Only verified agencies can contact talent
contact.needVerifiedBody: This keeps talent safe from fake agents. Ask us to verify your agency; it usually takes a day or two.
contact.pending: Your agency verification is with a moderator. You can contact talent once it is approved.
contact.needEmail: Verify your email to contact talent

welcome.headline: Get seen by the people who scout talent.
welcome.body: Show your best work. Agents and scouts across Nigeria search here for athletes, musicians, models, actors and creators.

trust.control: You choose who you talk to

preview.request: Eko Talent Partners would like to contact you

sides.title: One stage, two sides
sides.talentBody: Build a profile agents actually want to read, and let opportunities come to you.
sides.talent1: A portfolio of your best photos and clips, in the order you choose
sides.talent2: Found by verified agents searching your discipline and city
sides.talent3: Read every request first, then accept only the ones you want
sides.agentBody: Find the next headline act before anyone else, without the guesswork.
sides.agent1: Search by discipline, city and age, and see real work at a glance
sides.agent2: Keep a shortlist with private notes for every search you run
sides.agent3: Contact talent directly once your agency is verified

how.title: How it works
how.step1Body: Pick your discipline and city, add a photo and tell your story. It takes about five minutes.
how.step2Body: Upload photos and clips. Every file is checked before anyone else can see it.
how.step3Body: Verified agents find you in search and send a request. You decide whether to chat.

safety.title: Safety is the product
safety.body: Fake agents are the biggest risk on talent platforms. We designed Raising Talents around stopping them.
safety.verifiedBody: A moderator confirms that each agent works for the agency they name before they can contact anyone.
safety.controlBody: Nobody can message you until you accept. Decline or report with one tap.
safety.privateBody: Your date of birth, email and phone number are never shown. Agents see your age in years only.

cta.title: Your next opportunity is looking for you.
cta.body: Join free in a few minutes. You need to be 18 or older.

footer.made: Made in Lagos for talent across Nigeria.

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.subtitle: You need to be 18 or older to join.
signUp.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. A short phrase is easy to remember.
signUp.dateOfBirthHint: Only used to confirm your age. Never shown on your profile.
signUp.terms: I agree to the Terms and the Community Guidelines.
signUp.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in

signIn.title: Welcome back
signIn.passwordChanged: Your password was changed. Sign in with the new one.

verifyEmail.title: Verify your email
verifyEmail.body: We send 6-digit codes to {email}. Each lasts 10 minutes, and you can ask for a new one at any time.
verifyEmail.resent: New code sent. Check your inbox and spam folder.
verifyEmail.whyTalent: Until you do, your profile stays private and agents cannot find you.
verifyEmail.whyAgent: You need this before asking us to verify your agency.
verifyEmail.doneBody: Thank you. Everything is open to you now.

chooseRole.title: How will you use Raising Talents?
chooseRole.body: This decides what your profile looks like. You can change it until you finish setting up.
chooseRole.talentBody: Build a portfolio of your work so agents and scouts can find you.
chooseRole.agentTitle: I am an agent or scout
chooseRole.agentBody: Search for talent and get in touch. Agents are verified before they can message anyone.

home.bodyTalent: Next you will add your discipline, a photo and your first clips.
home.bodyAgent: Next you will confirm your agency details and get verified.
home.talentReadyBody: Keep your portfolio fresh: agents look for recent work.
home.agentPending: Verification pending. We will email you when your agency is verified; you can then contact talent.
home.agentSearchSoon: Search by name, discipline, city and age. We verify every agent before they can contact talent.
home.viewProfile: See your profile as agents do
home.managePortfolioBody: Add photos and clips, caption them and set the order.
home.viewProfileBody: Check what agents see before they contact you.
home.editProfileBody: Update your discipline, city, skills and story.
home.findTalentBody: Search by name, discipline, city and age.
home.attentionBody: New requests and messages from verified agents.
home.noMessagesTalent: No messages yet. Verified agents who like your work will contact you here.
home.noMessagesAgent: No conversations yet. Find talent you like and send a request.
home.portfolioEmpty: Add your first photo or clip so agents can see what you do.
home.tip: Agents look for recent work. Adding something new each month keeps you near the top of their minds.
home.agentHeroBody: Search talent across Nigeria by discipline, city and age.
home.shortlistEmpty: Save talent from their profile to compare them here.
home.photoInReview: Your photo is with a moderator
home.photoInReviewBody: Agents will see your profile as soon as it is approved. Keep adding your work in the meantime.
home.photoNeededBody: Agents only see profiles with an approved photo. Your last one was not approved.

restore.offlineBody: Raising Talents needs a connection to load your account. It will try again when you are back online.

validation.dateInvalid: Enter your date of birth as DD/MM/YYYY.

validation.codeInvalid: Enter the 6-digit code from the email.
validation.websiteInvalid: Use a full address starting with https://

errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Some details need fixing. Check the highlighted fields.
errors.EMAIL_ALREADY_REGISTERED: An account with this email already exists. Sign in instead.
errors.UNDER_MINIMUM_AGE: You need to be 18 or older to join Raising Talents.
errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: That email and password do not match.
errors.ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED: This account is suspended. Check your email for details.
errors.ACCOUNT_BANNED: This account has been closed for breaking the Community Guidelines.

errors.SESSION_REVOKED: You were signed out to keep your account safe. Sign in again.
errors.VERIFICATION_CODE_INVALID: That code is not right. Check the email and try again.
errors.VERIFICATION_CODE_EXPIRED: That code has expired. Send a new one.
errors.VERIFICATION_ATTEMPTS_EXCEEDED: Too many wrong codes. Send a new one.
errors.VERIFICATION_RESEND_TOO_SOON: Wait a moment before asking for another code.
errors.ROLE_ALREADY_LOCKED: Your role is set. Contact support to change it.
errors.PRECONDITION_REQUIRED: Reload your profile, then try saving again.
errors.PRECONDITION_FAILED: Your profile was changed on another device. We have loaded the latest version; check it and save again.

errors.MEDIA_TOO_LARGE: That file is too large. Photos can be up to 15 MB and videos up to 300 MB.

errors.MEDIA_UPLOAD_MISMATCH: Something went wrong with that upload. Choose the photo again.
errors.MEDIA_WRONG_STATE: This photo is already being processed.
errors.MEDIA_WRONG_PURPOSE: That photo was uploaded for something else. Choose it again from your gallery.
errors.MEDIA_ALREADY_USED: That photo is already in your portfolio.

errors.PORTFOLIO_ORDER_MISMATCH: Your portfolio changed on another device. We have loaded the latest order; try again.

errors.AGENT_PROFILE_INCOMPLETE: Finish your agency profile before asking to be verified.
errors.VERIFICATION_PENDING: Your request is with a moderator. We will decide soon.
errors.SHORTLIST_FULL: Your shortlist is full. Remove someone to save another.
errors.AGENT_NOT_VERIFIED: Only verified agencies can contact talent. Ask us to verify your agency first.
errors.CONTACT_REQUEST_PENDING: You have already asked. The talent has not answered yet.
errors.CONTACT_DECLINED_RECENTLY: This talent declined your request recently. You can ask again later.
errors.CONVERSATION_CLOSED: This conversation is closed, so new messages cannot be sent.

crash.title: Something went wrong
crash.body: The app hit a problem it could not recover from. Your account and your work are safe.

pwa.updateReady: A new version of Raising Talents is ready.
pwa.offlineReady: Raising Talents now opens even without a connection.
pwa.installBody: Add Raising Talents to your home screen to open it like any other app.
pwa.installIos: To install, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
pwa.offline: You are offline. Changes will not save until you reconnect.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The link may be old, or the page has moved.

titles.chooseRole: Choose how you will use Raising Talents

onboarding.staleReloaded: Your profile was changed on another device. We loaded the latest version; check it and save again.

about.title: About you
about.body: This is how agents will see you.
about.displayNameHint: Your real name or the name you perform under.
about.handleHint: Agents can open your profile by it. Letters, numbers, dots and underscores.
about.genderSearchableHint: Some castings ask for a specific gender. Leave this off and your gender stays off search.

discipline.title: Your discipline
discipline.body: Pick what you do, so the right agents find you.
discipline.pickCategoryFirst: Choose a category to see the options.

location.title: Where you are
location.body: Agents often search near them first.

story.title: Your story
story.body: A few lines about your experience and what you are looking for.

photo.title: Your profile photo
photo.body: A clear, recent photo of your face. Agents see it first.
photo.checking: Checking your photo. This usually takes a few seconds.
photo.held: A moderator is checking your photo. We will let you know when it is approved.
photo.heldTitle: Your photo is with a moderator
photo.heldBody: You do not have to wait. Start adding your work now: agents will see your profile as soon as the photo is approved, and we will let you know.
photo.slow: This is taking longer than usual. Try again in a moment.
photo.done: Your profile is complete. Agents can find you now.

agent.title: Your agency
agent.body: Talent see this before accepting a contact request.
agent.jobTitleHint: For example Talent scout or Casting director.
agent.done: Your agency profile is saved. We verify every agent before they can contact talent; we will email you when you are verified.

media.typeNotAllowed: Use a photo (JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC) or a video (MP4 or MOV).
media.photoOnly: Use a photo in JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC format.
media.imageTooLarge: That photo is over 15 MB. Choose a smaller one.
media.videoTooLarge: That video is over 300 MB. Choose a shorter clip.
media.videoTooLong: That video is {seconds} seconds long. Clips can be up to 60 seconds; trim it and try again.
media.uploadFailed: The upload did not finish. Check your connection and try again.

portfolio.title: Your portfolio
portfolio.body: Up to {max} photos and clips of your best work. Agents see them in this order.
portfolio.full: Your portfolio is full. Remove an item to add another.
portfolio.empty: Nothing here yet. Start with your strongest work.
portfolio.caption: Caption
portfolio.captionHint: Up to {max} characters. Say where and when.
portfolio.removeConfirm: Remove this item? Its file is deleted too.
portfolio.heldBody: A moderator is checking this item. Only you can see it until then.
portfolio.processingBody: Only you can see this until it is checked.

search.title: Find talent
search.body: Search by name, skill or discipline, then narrow it down.
search.queryPlaceholder: For example: afrobeats singer, striker, runway
search.genderHint: Only talent who chose to be found by gender are filtered.
search.noResults: No talent matches yet. Try fewer filters or a different word.
search.ageRange: Ages must be between 18 and 99, youngest first.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.body: Enter the email you signed up with. If it has an account, we will send a 6-digit code.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.body: If {email} has an account, a 6-digit code is on its way. It expires in 10 minutes.
resetPassword.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. Every device will be signed out.
resetPassword.resent: If the email has an account, a new code is on its way.

moderation.title: Moderation queue
moderation.body: Files the scanner was unsure about, oldest first. Only you and the owner can see them until you decide.
moderation.other: Breaks the Community Guidelines in another way
moderation.approved: Approved. The owner can use it now.
moderation.rejected: Rejected. The owner sees the reason.
moderation.previewAlt: Held photo uploaded by an account
moderation.agentsBody: Check that each person works for the agency they name. Oldest first.
moderation.agency_not_confirmed: Could not confirm they work there
moderation.details_do_not_match: Details do not match the evidence
moderation.agentVerified: Verified. The agent now has the badge.
moderation.agentDeclined: Declined. The agent sees the reason and can try again.
moderation.reportsBody: Accounts members reported, longest waiting first. Reporters stay anonymous. Every decision is recorded with your name.
moderation.conversationEvidence: What they wrote in the reported conversation
moderation.suspendExplain: Suspending signs them out, hides their profile and emails them the reason with a way to appeal. An operator can lift it.
moderation.banExplain: Banning closes the account for good. Use it for scams, impersonation, under 18s and repeated harm.

verification.title: Get verified
verification.body: Talent only accept contact from verified agents. Show us that you work for your agency; a moderator checks every request by hand.
verification.evidence: A page that shows you work there
verification.evidenceHint: For example your agency's team page, or its official Instagram or LinkedIn page that names you. Must start with https://
verification.registrationHint: As printed on the certificate, for example RC 123456 or BN 1234567.
verification.sent: Sent. A moderator will check it, usually within two working days.
verification.pending: Verification requested on {date}. A moderator is checking it.
verification.verified: Verified. Talent can see your agency is genuine.
verification.notReady: Finish your agency profile first, then ask to be verified.
verification.verifyEmailFirst: Verify your email first. We use it to check that you work for the agency.

account.title: Your account
account.dataBody: Download everything Raising Talents holds about you: your account, profile, portfolio and files, as one JSON file.
account.deleteBody: Your profile and portfolio are hidden from agents at once. After {days} days we erase the account and every file for good. Until then you can change your mind.
account.confirm: I understand my profile, portfolio and files will be erased.
account.scheduled: Your account will be deleted on {date}. It is hidden from agents until then.
account.kept: Your account is back. Nothing will be deleted.

report.title: Report this profile
report.body: A moderator will look at it. The person will not know who reported them.
report.fake_or_impersonation: Fake, or pretending to be someone else
report.scam_or_harassment: Asking for money, scamming or harassing
report.noteHint: Do not include your own contact details.
report.thanks: Thank you. A moderator will look at this profile.
report.conversationBody: A moderator will see the messages the other person sent here, not yours. They will not know who reported them.
report.conversationThanks: Thank you. A moderator will look at this conversation. You do not have to reply in the meantime.

shortlist.title: Your shortlist
shortlist.body: Talent you saved, newest first. Your notes are private: talent never see them or know they were saved.
shortlist.emptyBody: Save talent from their profile to compare them later and keep notes.
shortlist.removeHint: . Press to remove {name} from your shortlist
shortlist.allHidden: Your saved talent are hidden right now
shortlist.allHiddenBody: They stay on your shortlist and come back here if their profiles return.

security.passwordBody: Change it whenever you like. Every other device is signed out, and we email you to confirm.
security.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other devices are signed out.
security.wrongCurrent: That is not your current password.
security.devicesBody: Sign out any device you do not recognise, then change your password.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.emptyBody: Decisions about your photos, videos, verification and account will appear here.
notifications.mediaApprovedBody: It is on your profile now.
notifications.agentVerifiedBody: Your profile now shows the verified badge.
notifications.agentDeclined: We could not verify your agency yet
notifications.deletionScheduled: Your account will be deleted on {date}
notifications.deletionScheduledBody: Changed your mind? Keep your account from your account page.
notifications.reinstatedBody: You can use Raising Talents again, and agents can see your profile.
notifications.passwordChangedBody: If this was not you, change your password and sign out your other devices.
notifications.emailChangedBody: Emails from us now go to your new address. If this was not you, contact support straight away.
notifications.contactRequestedBody: Read their message, then accept to start chatting or decline.
notifications.contactDeclinedBody: Keep searching: there are many more talented people to discover.

emailChange.title: Email address
emailChange.body: We will send a code to the new address. Nothing changes until you enter it, and we tell your current address either way.
emailChange.codeSent: We sent a 6-digit code to {email}. It expires in 10 minutes.
emailChange.done: Your email address is changed. Use it next time you sign in.

routeError.title: Something went wrong
routeError.body: This screen could not be shown. We have been told, and trying again usually works.
routeError.updateBody: Raising Talents was updated while this page was open. Reload to carry on.
routeError.offlineBody: This screen needs a connection. Check your signal, then try again.

verifyBanner.talent: Verify your email so agents can find your profile.
verifyBanner.agent: Verify your email to ask us to verify your agency.
verifyBanner.other: Verify your email to use everything Raising Talents offers.
